en.headline: Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retains top global innovation ranking
en.dek: The World Intellectual Property Organization’s 2026 Global Innovation Index again places the cluster first, citing patent filings, scientific publications and venture-capital deals; the Hong Kong government welcomed the result.
body: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou innovation cluster has been ranked the world’s top innovation hub for the second consecutive year in the Global Innovation Index 2026 released by the World Intellectual Property Organization on Tuesday.

According to WIPO, the ranking is based on three metrics measured per million inhabitants over the past five years: international patent filings under the Patent Cooperation Treaty, scientific publications, and the number of venture-capital deals. The cluster recorded 2,259 PCT applications, 4,060 scientific articles and 138 venture-capital deals on that basis. Tokyo-Yokohama, San Jose-San Francisco, Seoul and Beijing followed in the top five.

A Hong Kong government spokesman welcomed the ranking, saying it reaffirmed the Greater Bay Area’s outstanding innovative capacity and its financing ecosystem for innovation and technology. The spokesman said Hong Kong would continue to align with the national 15th Five-Year Plan, deepen cross-boundary collaboration and strengthen its role as an international innovation and technology centre. The number of start-ups in Hong Kong rose from more than 1,500 in 2015 to over 5,200 in 2025, while Hong Kong Science Park and Cyberport have together nurtured around 20 unicorns.

zh.headline: 深圳—香港—廣州創新集群連續第二年全球排名第一
zh.dek: 世界知識產權組織《2026年全球創新指數》再次將該集群列為全球首強，指標包括專利、科學論文及風險投資；特區政府表示歡迎。
body: 世界知識產權組織周二公布《2026年全球創新指數》百強創新集群排名，「深圳—香港—廣州」集群連續第二年位列全球第一。
該排名根據過去五年每百萬人口的三項指標計算：透過《專利合作條約》提交的國際專利申請量、科學論文發表量，以及風險資本交易量。該集群分別錄得2,259宗PCT申請、4,060篇科學論文及138宗風險投資交易。東京—橫濱、聖荷西—三藩市、首爾及北京緊隨其後。
香港特區政府發言人表示歡迎有關排名，指這再次肯定粵港澳大灣區卓越的創新能力及支持創科的資金生態。發言人表示，香港會繼續對接國家「十五五」規劃，深化跨境合作，強化國際創科中心定位。香港初創企業數目由2015年逾1,500間增至2025年超過5,200間，科學園與數碼港合共孕育約20家獨角獸企業。
